He placed it on the windowsill of the lighthouse, beside six others collected over the years, each a small ghost of someone's passing thought, each a reminder that the sea connects strangers across distances neither will ever cross.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯把空荡荡的街道染成橙黄色，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车灯划破寂静。便利店还亮着灯，值夜班的店员靠在柜台上打盹。远处传来清洁车缓慢碾过路面的声音，像是城市在翻身。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有零星几盏还亮着，不知是谁在熬夜工作，还是失眠难眠。风里带着一丝凉意和未散尽的霓虹味道。整座城市仿佛在等待着什么，等待第一班地铁的轰鸣，等待天边泛起的第一丝微光，重新唤醒这片沉睡的钢筋森林。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a function calls itself to solve a smaller piece of the same problem.\n- Imagine Russian nesting dolls: each doll contains a smaller one, until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open anymore.\n- In code, that 'tiniest doll' is called the base case, and it's what stops the function from calling itself forever."}
